task_definition.task_description: Please check the weather in London and the current local time there. I also need you to get the weather alert card for London, archive that card to my Trip Weather Archive with medium priority for user_1234, and then look up the timeline for flight AA100. After that, publish my stay details for The Ritz starting December 1st, and finally send me a high-priority push notification to let me know the briefing, archive, and stay details are updated.
